verdict.rationale: Pipecat's docs include an api-reference section, but the evidence only shows CLI reference pages. The context-hub is a local docs, examples and API index served to coding agents over MCP, which is an adjacent feature, not an interactive reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, and nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples inside an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
